_note: Royal Caribbean cruiseSearch group ids per tracked itinerary row. These are the join key between lp-system/data/03_itineraries.csv (itin_id) and the official cruiseSearch response (cruises[].id). Promoted out of a dated cache dir on 2026-10-18 so auto_rates.py has a permanent source. A group id changes only if Royal Caribbean re-issues the package; if a row goes absent for several runs, confirm here before retiring it. _ships must list EVERY ship prefix appearing in groups: query B is per ship and a row whose ship is missing gets A-only, which can never satisfy the two-query confirmation and is held forever. Miami and Port Canaveral were added 2026-10-21 without their ships and were held on every run until 2026-10-26.
